subtitle: Master sophisticated jazz harmony and melodic construction through theoretical understanding

introduction.title: The Language of Sophisticated Harmony
introduction.text: Jazz guitar riffs outline chord progressions from the inside out, utilizing chord-tone targeting, chromatic enclosures, and voice-leading principles rather than static box patterns. By analyzing classic ii-V-I licks, Wes Montgomery-style octaves, and bebop guide-tone lines, you learn how to weave sophisticated melodic phrases that gracefully navigate rapid harmonic changes.

columns.title: Harmonic Complexity
columns.text: Jazz guitar involves sophisticated harmonic concepts including extended chords, altered scales, and complex voice leading. Understanding these elements is essential for authentic jazz expression.

columns.title: Melodic Sophistication
columns.text: Jazz melodies use advanced scalar concepts, chromatic approach tones, and bebop language to create flowing lines that outline complex harmonic progressions.

cards.title: Chord Extensions
cards.description: Adding 9ths, 11ths, and 13ths to basic triads for sophisticated harmony

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Extensions follow scale degrees - 9th (2nd octave), 11th (4th octave), 13th (6th octave)

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Cmaj7 becomes Cmaj9, Cmaj9#11, Cmaj13 - each adding harmonic complexity

cards.title: Tritone Substitution
cards.description: Replacing dominant chords with dominant chords a tritone away

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: G7 can be replaced with Db7 - both contain same tritone (B-F)

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Creates sophisticated bass movement and harmonic surprise

cards.title: Voice Leading
cards.description: Smooth movement between chord tones to create melodic bass and inner voices

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Common tones remain static, other voices move stepwise when possible

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Creates flowing chord progressions that sound like multiple independent melodies

cards.title: Chromatic Approach

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Approach from above or below by semitone to create tension and resolution

fields.label: Application
